title: Volunteer Handbook
key_sentences: Thank you for volunteering at the twelfth Lowmoor Folk & Lantern Festival.
More than four hundred volunteers make the festival possible, from the people who build the lantern trail to those who greet visitors at the gate.
This handbook explains what we expect of you and what you can expect from us.
Every volunteer must complete the online registration form and choose at least three shifts.
The general induction is compulsory for everyone, including volunteers who have helped in previous years.
Shifts last four hours and include a twenty-minute break.
Wear your volunteer tabard at all times while on duty, and drink plenty of water in hot weather.
Call the control room on channel 1 of your radio, or dial the number on the back of your pass.
Take the child to the welfare tent next to the main gate and stay with them.
Every volunteer who completes three shifts receives a free weekend ticket for next year's festival.

list_items.text: • checking tickets and exchanging them for wristbands
• counting entries every hour and reporting the figures to the control room
– no visitors without a backstage pass
– no glass bottles at any time
• helping children carry and light their lanterns
• guiding the procession along the river path
Report any hazard to your team leader straight away.
Do not lift anything heavier than you can manage comfortably.
Never block an emergency exit or a fire lane.
(i) Treat visitors, artists and other volunteers with courtesy and respect.
(ii) Do not drink alcohol before or during a shift.
(iii) Do not post photographs of children or of the backstage area on social media.
(iv) Tell your team leader if you cannot attend a shift, as early as possible.
